answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 158443 Country: Pakistan Title: Dua for marriage Question: Since past 3 years I am doing many wazifahs and duas for getting married but still unsuccessful. I am 26 years and very depressed. Please pray for me and suggest any dua for getting married soon. Answer ID: 158443 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 633/466/SN=5/1439) Read Ya Latif ( يا لطيف ) 1111 times every day after Isha prayer and before going to bed with durood before and after. Also write Surah Ahzab on some paper and put the paper in some box and place it in some proper place in your house. In-shaAllah, you shall have suitable proposal. (Amal-e-Qurani, p. 49, pub. Darul Kitab) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
